unit: second physical unit - distinct from the unit in fec_tacx_neo_2.json and from the unit in the fec_tacx_neo_2_* HCI corpora
transport: ANT+ FE-C full serial frames received as FEC2 BLE notifications
extractionRule: ALLOWLIST, not filter. Exactly one line shape is read: a QZ 'Characteristic change notification' for {6e40fec1-...} whose payload is one A4 09 4E 05 + 8-byte page + XOR frame. Every other line in the 48 MB source - settings dumps, Peloton and template configuration, Dircon definitions, telemetry from other devices - is never parsed and cannot reach this file.
privacy: Bluetooth addresses, device names, absolute times, unrelated traffic and all QZ application settings are excluded by construction (see extractionRule). Relative time begins at the session's first retained frame. Common Page 81 serial bytes are zeroed and the frame's XOR checksum recomputed.
provenanceWarning: The source log also contains lines of the form 'uuid=2a65 read=08000000' and 'uuid=2acc read=...'. Those belong to QZ's own Dircon VIRTUAL Wahoo KICKR bridge and describe what QZ publishes, not anything read from the Tacx Neo 2. They are not evidence about this trainer and must never be extracted as such.

sourceIntegrity.rejectionNote: Every retained frame passed the ANT envelope and XOR checksum unmodified. No frame was repaired, and none was dropped.

why: fec_tacx_neo_2.json holds 351 frames from two sessions on ONE unit. This is 7,969 frames
from a second, physically different Neo 2 - the same nine-service GATT, the same handle
layout, and Page 80 reporting the same hardware revision 1, manufacturer 89 and model 2850.
It is kept as a SIBLING rather than a third session of that file so that 'one fixture, one
machine' still holds and a per-unit claim stays separable.
It also fattens the pages the existing corpus barely covers: 899 Page 71 frames against 35,
and real counts on 0xF0/0xF9/0xFA/0xFC where that corpus has two or three of each.
relationshipToHciCorpora: Complementary. The fec_tacx_neo_2_ble_identity / _control_writes / _cycling_sensors / _link_timeline corpora are packet captures whose client never armed FEC2, so they contain no FE-C telemetry. This file is FE-C telemetry and nothing else. Neither supersedes the other.
doesNotResolve: Q33. QZ logs the characteristic inventory with handles but issues no ATT read, so Device Information strings and CP/CSC Feature values remain unobserved for the Neo 2 on this unit as well.

sessions.continuityNote: One unbroken connection. The largest gap between consecutive frames is 842 ms, so this is a single 34-minute session and not a reconnect sequence.

expectations: Raw physical replay corpus. Decode with the FE-C specification and the production codec; no mechanically generated decoded values are treated as goldens. Page 80 fields and the zeroed Page 81 serial are the exceptions and are asserted directly.
